## PROBLEM
Track B — deterministic orchestration foundation — is a separate program per audit doc §Final. Cannot start until Track A closes. Must integrate with the Specialists team's chain-templates program planned in:

- `~/dev/specialists/docs/design/roadmap/specialists-roadmap.md`
- `~/dev/specialists/docs/design/roadmap/enhanced-prd.md`

## SUCCESS
When Track A closes and Specialists chain-templates work is spec-ready, this epic gets decomposed into concrete child issues covering: canonical chain templates + resolver + exact deterministic dispatch, MSG-05 `waiting`-notification follow-up (only if measured need), extended live Suite C.

## SCOPE
Placeholder only. No child issues at this time.

## NON_GOALS
- Any work before Track A closure
- Duplicating the Specialists roadmap — this epic is the XTRM integration surface, not the Specialists implementation

## CONSTRAINTS
- Blocked-by all of Sprints 0–3
- Cannot claim / decompose until both `specialists-roadmap.md` and `enhanced-prd.md` are consumed and their XTRM touchpoints extracted

## VALIDATION
- [ ] Sprints 0–3 closed
- [ ] Specialists roadmap + PRD reviewed with concrete XTRM touchpoints extracted
- [ ] Decomposition PR (this epic → child issues) prepared

## OUTPUT
Track B child-issue plan (deferred artifact).
